status.description: Where the tab is: no-tab (no open tab matches domains) | tab.

ical-secret.description: Read a calendar's Secret address in iCal format and RETURN it (a credential). Capture with VAR=$(browser-harness-js ...) and pipe it to a secret store; never print it. Opens its own tab, reveals through the Security warning dialog, never clicks Reset.

calendarId.description: calendar id; for a primary calendar, the account email

timeoutMs.description: wait for the settings page, default 20000
